ideas.pitch: A local LLM-powered RPG companion engine that lets players converse naturally with any background character in real time, influencing plot progression.
ideas.title: AuraForge: Dynamic NPC Mindscapes
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven success of real-time voice and text interaction plugins for game characters, fulfilling the judging criteria for AI innovation in game development.

ideas.pitch: A 2D multiplayer cooperative puzzle game where two autonomous AI agents and one human player must collaborate, but underlying agent personalities drive spontaneous deception.
ideas.title: SplitWorld: The Deceptive Social Sandbox
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the difficult technical feat of emergent adversarial behavior in a live demo, appealing strongly to judges looking for novel AI interactions.

ideas.pitch: An educational visual novel with branching storylines that simulate local marine conservation crises and test players with real-world resource management tradeoffs.
ideas.title: Ecowave Chronicles: The Aquatic Quest
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a polished narrative format with a clear educational purpose, mirroring past winning projects at major civic-tech and hackathon competitions.

ideas.pitch: A fantasy strategy game featuring an autonomous AI bot that plays competitively via reinforcement learning and adapts its strategies to the user's playstyle.
ideas.title: Aethelgard: Autonomous Strategy Guild
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases genuinely hard engineering in autonomous agent integration within a strict 24-hour development timeline.

ideas.pitch: A real-time procedural platformer where the environment continuously generates and morphs mid-stream based on live audience chat prompts and sentiment.
ideas.title: RealmShift: Live Audience World-Builder
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers an interactive, highly engaging live demo that directly involves judges and audience members during the presentation phase.
